bearings.source: Timken/Aurora manufacturer catalogue table, sealed GE20ES-2RS row
bearings.material: Heat-treated 52100 steel ball and fractured race, protective coated
limits: The radial static limit is a bearing catalogue value, not an allowable load for the fabricated eye, pin, weld or complete brake.
No fatigue life follows from this static value.
Mounting spacers and housing can reduce available articulation below the catalogue angle.
Combined radial/axial loading, lubrication, contamination and oscillatory wear remain selection checks.
Supplier listing is evidence of a purchasable catalogue item, not assurance of enough stock for a coach.
Full shoulder must cross both shear planes; threads must not be the bearing surface at either plane.
Final grip stack must be longer than the actual shoulder, or use an expressly designed non-clamping retention arrangement.
Inner-ring spacers must contact only the bearing inner ring and preserve articulation.
The manufacturer warns that shoulder transition bearing areas, rather than property class alone, limit tightening torque.
Positive retention, corrosion protection, inspection interval and supplier traceability remain to be specified.

not_selected_alternative.reason: Catalogue threaded rod ends are an option, but their shank lengths make short two-ended hangers harder to package. Do not mix this manufacturer's ratings with Aurora or SKF ratings.
